args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Freight pricing this quarter — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Ironbark Tooling newsletter "Freight pricing this quarter," its linked article (https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight), and the article's companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion):

• Freight spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
